description: Experience the irresistible smoky aroma and succulent flavors of authentic Tandoori Chicken, perfected on a charcoal grill. This classic Indian dish features tender chicken marinated in a vibrant blend of yogurt and spices, then cooked to char-kissed perfection. A truly delightful and flavorful centerpiece for any Indian dinner spread.

instructions.title: Prepare Chicken
instructions.text: Clean the chicken thoroughly. Make deep gashes all over the chicken pieces with a sharp knife to allow the marinade to penetrate deeply. Pat dry completely with paper towels.

instructions.title: First Marinade
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the prepared chicken with salt and lemon juice. Rub the mixture well into the gashes and all over the chicken. Let it rest for 15 minutes at room temperature.

instructions.title: Second Marinade Preparation
instructions.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the thick plain yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, and a pinch of food color if desired. Add the mustard oil and mix until a smooth, vibrant marinade forms.

instructions.title: Marinate Chicken
instructions.text: Drain any excess liquid from the chicken after the first marinade. Apply the second marinade generously all over the chicken, ensuring it gets deeply into all the gashes. Cover the bowl tightly and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight, for the best flavor and tenderness.

instructions.title: Prepare Charcoal Grill
instructions.text: Light your charcoal grill and allow the coals to heat up until they are glowing red and covered with a fine grey ash. Arrange them for medium-high direct heat. Clean the grill grates thoroughly with a wire brush and oil them well to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: Grill Chicken to Perfection
instructions.text: Place the marinated chicken pieces directly over the medium-high heat on the grill. Grill for about 25-35 minutes, turning every 5-7 minutes to ensure even cooking and charring. Baste frequently with melted butter or ghee during grilling. Cook until the internal temperature of the thickest part of the chicken reaches 165F (74C) and the chicken is tender with beautiful char marks.

instructions.title: Serve Hot
instructions.text: Remove the Tandoori Chicken from the grill. Sprinkle generously with chaat masala. Garnish with fresh cilantro, onion rings, and lemon wedges. Serve immediately with mint chutney, raita, or warm naan bread for an authentic Indian dinner experience.

tips: For the most tender and flavorful Tandoori Chicken, marinate the chicken for at least 8 hours, or preferably overnight, allowing the spices to deeply penetrate the meat.
Using full-fat yogurt is crucial for a rich, creamy marinade that adheres well to the chicken and prevents it from drying out on the grill. Avoid low-fat yogurt as it can curdle.
Always start with a clean, oiled grill grate to prevent sticking. Baste the chicken regularly with melted butter or ghee during grilling to keep it moist and enhance its flavor and char.
